messages:
maya: Heads-up 12 after merging Telescope LoRA into the int8 runtime we9re seeing customer repros where long instructions (>1200 tokens) end up with sentence reordering mid-output. Anyone seen adapter-specific tokenizer/kv issues?
deploy-bot: canary: telescope-lora @ int8-smoke -> started (build 2026-03-12-tel-7)
juan: can you paste the minimal repro command?
maya: repro:
``
redwood run --model telescope-base:rev-3 --adapter telescope-lora:v1 \
  --quantize int8 --max-tokens 2048 --prompt-file tests/very_long_instructions.txt
```
observed: content "jumps" around token ~1250, sometimes repeats sentences.
tom: quick hypothesis: adapter added special tokens or remapped tokenizer ids and int8 kernels pad/cache differently -> token index drift at concat. Also past_kv dtype/offset mismatch possible.
lee: quick pack numbers (15 prompts): fp16 baseline: 0/15 shifts; int8 without adapter: 0/15; int8 with adapter: 5/15 shifts clustered >1k tokens.
juan: short mitigation: cast past_key_values to fp32/float16 before concat and re-run smoke. Cheap patch while we root cause.
tom: also check adapter init that calls tokenizer.add_special_tokens() 12 that can change token offsets. If adapter has that, confirm new token ids align across fp16/int8 paths.
maya: applying cast-patch to canary (build 2026-03-12-tel-7a) and re-running 15-pack now. console: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/telescope/2026-03-12
deploy-bot: canary update: 2026-03-12-tel-7a deployed -> running smoke 15/15
maya: initial run: int8+cast -> 1/15 shift (single outlier). collecting logs and tokenizer maps to diff vs baseline, will post follow-up.
